title: PCGExKnowledge concept pages
description: Concept documentation pages, extracted mechanically: the page's own description (frontmatter, or its opening sentence), its section outline, its live URL and, since bundle_schema 2.1.0, its prose as plain markdown.

id.description: Documentation path slug, unique per book.

plugin.description: The plugin whose book owns the page.

path.description: Page path in the book repository.

outline.description: The page's H2 headings, in order.

body.description: The page prose as markdown, GitBook syntax flattened: **Bold Name** references a node entry by display name, [Title](concept:<id>) references another concept page, hints are blockquotes opening with a bold label (Note, Warning, Danger, Tip), figures are reduced to their alt text. Absent when the page has no prose of its own.
